goal: Build an AI agent that answers natural-language Vietnamese questions directly on structured data (CSV, Excel, SQLite): given the raw files and a question, the agent returns a correct answer — or declines to answer (unanswerable) when the data cannot support the question.
domain: Anchored in the world of Vietnamese small businesses — the largest group of spreadsheet users in the country and the one with the richest, messiest real-world data — but the capability is general: natural-language question answering over tabular data.

input.data_package: A data package for one business: one or more files (.csv, .xlsx, .sqlite) plus a short README.md describing the business.
input.question: A question in everyday Vietnamese.
input.as_of_date: The 'today' against which relative time expressions ('tháng này', 'tuần rồi', 'cùng kỳ năm ngoái') are resolved.
input.shared: A rulebook and a solar–lunar calendar, shared by every business of the split.

output.final_answer: A final answer of one of the types in the Evaluation section: a value (number, percent, string, date, boolean, list, table), unanswerable when the data cannot support the question, or abstain when the agent chooses not to answer.

input_questions_jsonl.question: sp bán dc nhiều nhất tuần rồi là gì

output_submission_jsonl.answer: Xi măng Hà Tiên PCB40 bao 50kg
